active-recordings.text: active-recordings | Shows all active recordings with their start, duration and name. | columns: Start, Duration, Name, Destination, Max Age, Max Size

active-settings.text: active-settings | Shows the active settings for all event types. | columns: Event Type, Enabled, Threshold, Stack Trace, Period, Cutoff, Throttle

allocation-by-class.text: allocation-by-class | Shows the classes which have the highest allocation pressure.

allocation-by-class-detail.text: allocation-by-class-detail | Top 30 classes by sampled allocation weight (ObjectAllocationSample events). | columns: Class, Sample Events, Sampled Bytes, Avg Sample Weight

allocation-by-site.text: allocation-by-site | Shows the methods which have the highest allocation pressure. | columns: Allocation Pressure, Method

allocation-by-thread.text: allocation-by-thread | Shows the threads which have the highest allocation pressure. | columns: Thread, Allocation Pressure

allocation-rate.text: allocation-rate | Per-second allocation rate in MB/s (from ObjectAllocationSample events). Bucketed into 1-second windows. 'Sample MB/s' represents sampled allocation weight. | columns: Bucket, Sample MB/s, Samples

blocked-by-system-gc.text: blocked-by-system-gc | Shows the System.gc() calls which have blocked application threads the most. | columns: Time, Duration, Stack Trace

class-loaders.text: class-loaders | Shows all class loaders with their loaded class count and hidden class count. | columns: Class Loader, Hidden Classes, Classes

class-modifications.text: class-modifications | Shows all class redefinitions and retransforms with their duration, requested by and class count. | columns: Time, Requested By, Operation, Classes

compiler-configuration.text: compiler-configuration | Shows the configuration of the JIT compiler. | columns: Compiler Threads, Dynamic Compiler Threads, Tiered Compilation

compiler-phases.text: compiler-phases | Shows the phases of the concurrent compiler with their average, p95, longest, count and total duration. | columns: Level, Phase, Average, P95, Longest, Count, Total

compiler-statistics.text: compiler-statistics | Shows statistics about the JIT compiler. | columns: Compiled Methods, Peak Time, Total Time, Bailouts, OSR Compilations, Standard Compilations, OSR Bytes Compiled, Standard Bytes Compiled

container-configuration.text: container-configuration | Shows the configuration of the container in which the JVM is running. | columns: Container Type, CPU Slice Period, CPU Quota, CPU Shares, Effective CPU Count, Memory Soft Limit, Memory Limit, Swap Memory Limit

container-cpu-throttling.text: container-cpu-throttling | Shows the CPU throttling of the container in which the JVM is running. | columns: CPU Elapsed Slices, CPU Throttled Slices, CPU Throttled Time

container-cpu-usage.text: container-cpu-usage | Shows the CPU usage of the container in which the JVM is running. | columns: CPU Time, CPU User Time, CPU System Time

container-io-usage.text: container-io-usage | Shows the I/O usage of the container in which the JVM is running. | columns: Service Requests, Data Transferred

container-memory-usage.text: container-memory-usage | Shows the memory usage of the container in which the JVM is running. | columns: Memory Fail Count, Memory Usage, Swap Memory Usage

contention-by-address.text: contention-by-address | Shows the monitor addresses which have the highest contention time. | columns: Monitor Address, Class, Threads, Max Duration

contention-by-class.text: contention-by-class | Shows the classes which have the highest contention time. | columns: Lock Class, Count, Avg., P90, Max.

contention-by-site.text: contention-by-site | Shows the stack traces which have the highest contention time. | columns: StackTrace, Count, Avg., Max.

contention-by-thread.text: contention-by-thread | Shows the threads which have the highest contention time. | columns: Thread, Count, Avg, P90, Max.

cpu-information.text: cpu-information | Shows information about the CPU(s) on which the JVM is running. | columns: CPU, Sockets, Cores, Hardware Threads, Description

cpu-load.text: cpu-load | Shows statistics about the CPU load of the JVM and the machine. | columns: JVM User (Minimum), JVM User (Average), JVM User (Maximum), JVM System (Minimum), JVM System (Average), JVM System (Maximum), Machine Total (Minimum), Machine Total (Average)

cpu-load-samples.text: cpu-load-samples | Shows the CPU load samples of the JVM and the machine over time. | columns: Time, JVM User, JVM System, Machine Total

cpu-time-hot-methods.text: cpu-time-hot-methods | Identifies the top Java methods where the application spends the most CPU time, based on CPU time sampling data. | columns: Method, Samples, Percent

cpu-time-statistics.text: cpu-time-statistics | Provides statistics about CPU time sampling, including counts of successful, failed, biased, total, and lost samples. | columns: Successful Samples, Failed Samples, Biased Samples, Total Samples, Lost Samples

cpu-tsc.text: cpu-tsc | Shows information about the CPU Time Stamp Counter (TSC). | columns: Fast Time Auto Enabled, Fast Time Enabled, Fast Time Frequency, OS Frequency

deoptimizations-by-reason.text: deoptimizations-by-reason | Shows the reasons for deoptimizations and their counts. | columns: Reason, Count

deoptimizations-by-site.text: deoptimizations-by-site | Shows the methods where deoptimizations occurred and their counts. | columns: Method, Line Number, BCI, Count

deprecated-methods-for-removal.text: deprecated-methods-for-removal | Shows all deprecated methods which are marked for removal and the classes from which they are called. | columns: Deprecated Method, Called from Class

environment-variables.text: environment-variables | SELECT key AS "Key", value AS "Value" FROM InitialEnvironmentVariable GROUP BY key, value ORDER BY key | columns: Key, Value

events-by-count.text: events-by-count | Shows the locations in the code (methods) where exceptions are thrown, along with the count of how many times exceptions were thrown at each location. | columns: Event Label, Count

events-by-name.text: events-by-name | SELECT label AS "Event Label", count AS "Count" FROM Events JOIN EventLabels ON Events.name = EventLabels.name ORDER BY Events.name A | columns: Event Label, Count

exception-by-message.text: exception-by-message | SELECT message AS "Message", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM ( SELECT message FROM JavaErrorThrow UNION ALL | columns: Message, Count

exception-by-site.text: exception-by-site | SELECT (c.javaName || '.' || m.name || m.descriptor) AS "Method", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM ( SELECT stackTrace$topNonInitMethod as ni FROM JavaErrorThrow | columns: Method, Count

exception-by-type.text: exception-by-type | SELECT c.javaName AS "Class", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM ( SELECT thrownClass FROM JavaErrorThrow UNION ALL | columns: Class, Count

exception-count.text: exception-count | SELECT LAST(throwables) - FIRST(throwables) AS "Exceptions Thrown" FROM ExceptionStatistics | columns: Exceptions Thrown

file-reads-by-path.text: file-reads-by-path | Shows the file write operations grouped by file path. | columns: Path, Reads, Total Read

file-writes-by-path.text: file-writes-by-path | SELECT path AS "Path", COUNT(*) AS "Writes", format_memory(SUM(bytesWritten)) AS "Total Written" FROM FileWrite GROUP BY path | columns: Path, Writes, Total Written

finalizers.text: finalizers | Shows statistics about finalizers grouped by the class of the objects being finalized. | columns: Finalizable Class, Objects, Total Finalizers Run

gc.text: gc | Provides a summary of all garbage collection events, including start time, type, heap usage before and after GC, and the longest pause duration. | columns: Start, GC ID, Type, Heap Before GC, Heap After GC, Longest Pause

gc-allocation-trigger.text: gc-allocation-trigger | Identifies the application methods that most frequently trigger garbage collections due to memory allocation requests. | columns: Trigger Method (Non-JDK), Count, Total Requested

gc-concurrent-phases.text: gc-concurrent-phases | Shows the pause phases of the garbage collector with their type, name, average, p95, longest, count, and total duration. | columns: Name, Average, P95, Longest, Count, Total

gc-concurrent-phases-detail.text: gc-concurrent-phases-detail | All concurrent (non-stop-the-world) GC phase events ordered by start time. | columns: Start, Phase, GC ID, Duration

gc-configuration.text: gc-configuration | SELECT LAST(youngCollector) AS "Young GC", LAST(oldCollector) AS "Old GC", LAST(parallelGCThreads) AS "Parallel GC Threads", LAST(concurrentGCThreads) AS "Con | columns: Young GC, Old GC, Parallel GC Threads, Concurrent GC Threads, Dynamic GC Threads, Concurrent Explicit GC, Disable Explicit GC, Pause Target

gc-cpu-time.text: gc-cpu-time | Summarizes the CPU time consumed by garbage collection. | columns: GC User Time, GC System Time, GC Wall Clock Time, Total Time, GC Count

gc-efficiency.text: gc-efficiency | Bytes reclaimed per millisecond of pause for each collection. Low efficiency values indicate collections that paused long but freed little. | columns: GC ID, Cause, Pause, Reclaimed, MB/s reclaimed

gc-overhead.text: gc-overhead | Rolling GC overhead percentage in 10-second windows. High values (>5%) indicate the application is spending significant time in GC. | columns: Window, GC Overhead %, Pause ms, Collections

gc-parallel-phases.text: gc-parallel-phases | SELECT name AS "Name", format_duration(AVG(duration)) AS "Average", format_duration(P95(duration)) AS "P95", format_duration(MAX(duration)) AS "Longest", | columns: Name, Average, P95, Longest, Count, Total

gc-pause-distribution.text: gc-pause-distribution | Pause-time distribution per GC phase: p50/p90/p99/max by phase name. Useful for pinpointing which GC sub-phase contributes most to latency. | columns: Phase, Count, Min, Median, P90, P99, Max, Total

gc-pause-phases.text: gc-pause-phases | SELECT eventTypeLabel AS "Type", name AS "Name", format_duration(AVG(duration)) AS "Average", format_duration(P95(duration)) AS "P95", format_dura | columns: Type, Name, Average, P95, Longest, Count, Total

gc-pauses.text: gc-pauses | Shows statistics about the garbage collection pauses including total pause time and number of pauses. | columns: Total Pause Time, Number of Pauses, Minimum Pause Time, Median Pause Time, Average Pause Time, P90 Pause Time, P95 Pause Time, P99 Pause Time

gc-phase-breakdown.text: gc-phase-breakdown | All pause-phase records ordered by GC ID and start time. Use to drill into which sub-phases make up each collection. | columns: GC ID, Phase, Duration, Start

gc-references.text: gc-references | SELECT FIRST(G.startTime) AS "Time", G.gcId AS "GC ID", S.count AS "Soft Ref.", W.count AS "Weak Ref.", P.count AS "Phant | columns: Time, GC ID, Soft Ref., Weak Ref., Phantom Ref., Final Ref., Total Count

gc-throughput.text: gc-throughput | GC vs mutator time ratio in 10-second windows. 'Throughput %' is the fraction of time the application was NOT paused by GC. | columns: Window, GC Time (ms), Mutator Time (ms), Throughput %

gc-top-pauses.text: gc-top-pauses | The 20 longest individual GC pause events, with start time, phase name and GC ID. | columns: Start Time, Phase, GC ID, Duration

gc-young-vs-old.text: gc-young-vs-old | Collection counts and total pause time grouped by GC cause, distinguishing young-gen vs old-gen collections. | columns: Cause, Collections, Total Pause, Avg Pause, Max Single Pause

heap-committed-vs-used.text: heap-committed-vs-used | Raw heap used vs committed in MB, suitable for LINE_CHART rendering. | columns: Time, Phase, Used MB

heap-configuration.text: heap-configuration | Displays the configuration settings of the JVM heap, including sizes and compressed oops usage. | columns: Initial Size, Minimum Size, Maximum Size, If Compressed Oops Are Used, Compressed Oops Mode

heap-summary-over-time.text: heap-summary-over-time | Heap used and committed size before and after each GC, ordered by time. Pair with LINE_CHART LINK_X for an interactive heap timeline. | columns: Time, GC ID, When, Heap Used

hot-methods.text: hot-methods | Identifies the top Java methods where the application spends the most execution time, based on sampling data. | columns: Method, Samples, Percent

jdk-agents.text: jdk-agents | Lists all JDK and native agents that were initialized, along with their initialization time and other info. | columns: Time, Initialization, Name, Options

jvm-flags.text: jvm-flags | Displays all JVM command line flags along with their current values. | columns: Name, Value

jvm-information.text: jvm-information | Summarizes various latency events by type, including counts and duration statistics. | columns: PID, VM Start, Name, Version, VM Arguments, Program Arguments

latencies-by-type.text: latencies-by-type | SELECT eventType AS "Event Type", COUNT(*) AS "Count", format_duration(AVG(duration)) AS "Average", format_duration(P99(duration)) AS "P 99", | columns: Event Type, Count, Average, P 99, Longest, Total

longest-class-loading.text: longest-class-loading | SELECT startTime AS "Time", c.javaName AS "Loaded Class", format_duration(duration) AS "Load Time" FROM ClassLoad cl JOIN Class c ON cl.loadedClass = c._i | columns: Time, Loaded Class, Load Time

longest-compilations.text: longest-compilations | SELECT startTime AS "Start Time", format_duration(duration) AS "Duration", (c.javaName || '.' || m.name) AS "Method", compileLevel AS "Compile Level", | columns: Start Time, Duration, Method, Compile Level, Succeeded

memory-leaks-by-class.text: memory-leaks-by-class | Provides timing statistics for methods, including invocation counts and time metrics. | columns: Alloc. Time, Object Class, Object Age, Heap Usage

memory-leaks-by-site.text: memory-leaks-by-site | SELECT LAST(allocationTime) AS "Alloc. Time", (c.javaName || '.' || m.name || m.descriptor) AS "Application Method", format_duration(LAST(objectAge)) AS "Object Age", | columns: Alloc. Time, Application Method, Object Age, Heap Usage

method-calls.text: method-calls | Displays method call relationships, showing which methods are called by which callers along with invocation counts. | columns: Traced Method, Caller, Invocations

method-timing.text: method-timing | SELECT (c.javaName || '.' || m.name || m.descriptor) AS "Timed Method", LAST(invocations) AS "Invocations", format_duration(LAST(minimum)) AS "Minimum Time", | columns: Timed Method, Invocations, Minimum Time, Average Time, Maximum Time

modules.text: modules | Identifies methods that caused monitor inflation, along with the associated monitor classes and duration statistics. | columns: Module Name

monitor-inflation.text: monitor-inflation | SELECT (c.javaName || '.' || m.name || m.descriptor) AS "Method", mc.javaName AS "Monitor Class", COUNT(*) AS "Count", format_duration(SUM(jmi.duration)) AS " | columns: Method, Monitor Class, Count, Total Duration

native-libraries.text: native-libraries | Lists any failures that occurred during the loading or unloading of native libraries, along with error messages. | columns: Name, Base Address, Top Address

native-library-failures.text: native-library-failures | SELECT eventType AS "Operation", name AS "Library", errorMessage AS "Error Message" FROM ( SELECT 'Native Library Unload' AS | columns: Operation, Library, Error Message

native-memory-committed.text: native-memory-committed | Identifies the top native methods where the application spends the most time, based on sampling data. | columns: Memory Type, First Observed, Average, Last Observed, Maximum

native-memory-reserved.text: native-memory-reserved | SELECT type AS "Memory Type", FIRST(reserved) AS "First Observed", format_memory(AVG(reserved)) AS "Average", LAST(reserved) AS "Last Observed", | columns: Memory Type, First Observed, Average, Last Observed, Maximum

native-methods.text: native-methods | SELECT (c.javaName || '.' || m.name || m.descriptor) AS "Method", COUNT(*) AS "Samples", format_percentage(COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NativeMethodSample)) AS "Percent" | columns: Method, Samples, Percent

network-utilization.text: network-utilization | Displays network utilization statistics for each network interface, including read and write rates. | columns: Network Interface, Avg. Read Rate, Max. Read Rate, Avg. Write Rate, Max. Write Rate

object-statistics.text: object-statistics | Summarizes object statistics by class, including counts, heap space usage, and increases over time. | columns: Class, Count, Heap Space, Increase

pinned-threads.text: pinned-threads | Identifies virtual threads that have been pinned, along with statistics on pinning duration and counts. | columns: Method, Pinned Count, Longest Pinning, Total Time Pinned

recording.text: recording | SELECT eventCount AS "Event Count", firstEvent AS "First Recorded Event", lastEvent AS "Last Recorded Event", format_duration(eventDurationSeconds) AS "Length of Recorded Events" | columns: Event Count, First Recorded Event, Last Recorded Event, Length of Recorded Events, Dump Reason

safepoint-overhead.text: safepoint-overhead | Per-safepoint overhead: total duration, synchronization time, and thread counts. Includes both GC and non-GC safepoints (deopt, class redefinition, etc.). | columns: Start, Safepoint ID, Sync Duration, Initial Threads, Running Threads

safepoints.text: safepoints | SELECT B.startTime AS "Start Time", format_duration(epoch(E.startTime - B.startTime)) AS "Duration", format_duration(S.duration) AS "State Synchronization", jniCriticalThreadCount AS "JNI Critical Thr | columns: Start Time, Duration, State Synchronization, JNI Critical Threads, Total Threads

socket-reads-by-host.text: socket-reads-by-host | SELECT host AS "Host", COUNT(*) AS "Reads", format_memory(SUM(bytesRead)) AS "Total Read" FROM SocketRead GROUP BY host ORDER | columns: Host, Reads, Total Read

socket-writes-by-host.text: socket-writes-by-host | SELECT host AS "Host", COUNT(*) AS "Writes", format_memory(SUM(bytesWritten)) AS "Total Written" FROM SocketWrite GROUP BY host | columns: Host, Writes, Total Written

system-information.text: system-information | SELECT format_memory(LAST(pm.totalSize)) AS "Total Physical Memory Size", LAST(osi.osVersion) AS "OS Version", LAST(vi.name) AS "Virtualization", LAST(cii.cpu) AS "CPU Type", | columns: Total Physical Memory Size, OS Version, Virtualization, CPU Type, Number of Cores, Number of Hardware Threads, Number of Sockets, CPU Description

system-processes.text: system-processes | SELECT FIRST(startTime) AS "First Observed", LAST(startTime) AS "Last Observed", pid AS "PID", FIRST(commandLine) AS "Command Line" FROM SystemProcess | columns: First Observed, Last Observed, PID, Command Line

system-properties.text: system-properties | SELECT key AS "Key", value AS "Value" FROM InitialSystemProperty GROUP BY key, value ORDER BY key ASC | columns: Key, Value

thread-allocation.text: thread-allocation | SELECT thread AS "Thread", LAST(allocated) AS "Allocated", format_percentage( LAST(allocated) * 1.0 / SUM(LAST(allocated)) OVER () ) AS "Perce | columns: Thread, Allocated, Percentage

thread-count.text: thread-count | SELECT startTime AS "Start Time", activeCount AS "Active Threads", daemonCount AS "Daemon Threads", accumulatedCount AS "Accumulated Threads", peakCount AS "Peak Thre | columns: Start Time, Active Threads, Daemon Threads, Accumulated Threads, Peak Threads

thread-cpu-load.text: thread-cpu-load | SELECT t.javaName AS "Thread", format_percentage(LAST(system)) AS "System", format_percentage(LAST(user)) AS "User" FROM ThreadCPULoad JOIN Thread t ON Th | columns: Thread, System, User

thread-start.text: thread-start | SELECT CASE WHEN j.ts_start IS NOT NULL THEN j.ts_start ELSE NULL END AS "Start Time", CASE WHEN c.jav | columns: Start Time, Stack Trace, Thread, Duration

tlab-efficiency.text: tlab-efficiency | TLAB fill ratio per 5-second window. A fill ratio close to 1.0 means TLABs are well-sized; a low ratio means many half-empty TLABs are retired early. | columns: Bucket (5s), Fill Ratio, Allocations, Total TLAB, Total Allocated

tlabs.text: tlabs | SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(tlabSize) AS "Inside Count", format_memory(MIN(tlabSize)) AS "Inside Minimum Size", format_memory(AVG(tlabSize)) AS "Inside Average Size", format_memo | columns: Inside Count, Inside Minimum Size, Inside Average Size, Inside Maximum Size, Inside Total Allocation, Outside Count, Outside Minimum Size, Outside Average Size

vm-operations.text: vm-operations | SELECT operation AS "VM Operation", format_duration(AVG(duration)) AS "Average Duration", format_duration(MAX(duration)) AS "Longest Duration", COUNT(*) AS "Count", | columns: VM Operation, Average Duration, Longest Duration, Count, Total Duration
